title: Modal, Web Animation by @jeetnirnejak: Sandbox Limits: a panel for starving a job. pull the cpu and memory ce
notes:
Sandbox Limits: a panel for starving a job. pull the cpu and memory ceilings, hit run, see if it finishes or gets killed. when usage hits the cap the line isn't a ruler. it's a beam pinned at both ends. it bows up a few pixels on a spring, so contact lands with a little flex.

Designer: @jeetnirnejak. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
